evidence_classes.competitor_features: Observed pinned primary README statements; no competitor execution.
evidence_classes.nizam_foundation: Captured local phase017 artifacts; not comparative task evidence.
evidence_classes.thresholds: Proposed acceptance targets; no empirical result implied.

documented_comparison.test_question: Can Nizam match onboarding and appropriate process depth while improving verifiable recovery?
Which method minimizes brownfield regressions and operator effort?
documented_comparison.preview_policy: Separate optional sensitivity arm, never mixed with stable.

documented_comparison.test_question: Does Nizam improve requirement-drift detection and independent verification without excessive overhead?

activation_preconditions: Orchestrator confirms dependency satisfaction and authorized phase selection.
Actual required capability preflight passes on the chosen host; unknown/unsupported is non-passing.
No workstation sysctl change or allow-unsupported waiver.
Generator contract, both independent pre-code gates, then implementation/QA/capture under installed governance.
Benchmark adapters get independent fidelity review, sealed holdouts, explicit compute ceiling and analysis preregistration before scored work.

work_packages.name: Stage measurement and preregistration
implementation_preconditions: Reviewed planning/spec/feature artifacts and own approved contract
Runtime instrumentation aligns with 016 interfaces; no changes to that phase scope by implication
deliverables: Existing-stage timing/token/cost/intervention ledger with actual model and price identity
Four-arm fidelity review and common-runtime eligibility
Sealed task manifest design and analysis preregistration
Cheap static/synthetic screening and diagnostic smoke/pilot report ranking bounded repairs by observed failure and overhead.
acceptance_facts: Synthetic staged traces reconcile total agent tokens, overlapping wall time, costs, failures and intervention minutes without double counting.
Missing model/price/exit/revision fields produce explicit unknown/non-passing metrics.
Preregistration precedes scored results and binds adapter, task, analysis and budget hashes.
work_packages.benefit_hypothesis: Separate productive work, coordination, infrastructure waits, and repair to choose the highest-value improvement.

work_packages.name: Held-out paired trials and independent reproduction
deliverables: Task-family corpus with hidden independent checks
Isolated paired executor and durable all-attempt records using existing runtime tools
Reproducible statistical report and independent replay
acceptance_facts: Planted false completion, unsafe write, timeout, stale receipt, and holdout access attempts never score successful.
Same budget and paired interventions apply to every primary arm; unsupported runs remain recorded.
Known synthetic effects and null outcomes exercise ratio bounds, rare-event bounds and multiplicity control before results are revealed.
A second evaluator reconstructs scores and uncertainty from published inputs.
work_packages.benefit_hypothesis: Replace comparative opinion with bounded reproducible evidence.

work_packages.name: Onboarding and measured profile improvements
deliverables: Concise task-entry and recovery guidance in existing entrypoints
One selected overhead repair justified by EX-P1 pilot evidence, with explicit architecture triage
Counterbalanced novice study and fresh held-out candidate comparison
acceptance_facts: First-time operators complete setup and recover an interrupted task from documented instructions; active minutes/errors are captured.
Selected profile passes existing independent review and QA; no missed baseline blocker or stale evidence reuse.
Improvement decision uses preregistered thresholds and fails on inconclusive precision.
work_packages.benefit_hypothesis: Reduce avoidable user effort and process churn without weakening independent evidence.
implementation_preconditions: A measured pilot identifies an actionable bottleneck; no large confirmation prerequisite.
Changes to profiles still wait for 019 and their own approved contract.

provisional_budget.note: Planning estimates only; no benchmark spend or phase rebaseline authorized by this artifact.

primary_arms: Nizam pinned authored source plus separate installed governance identity
Spec Kit pinned revision with task-appropriate bundled extension

pilot.purpose: Validate harness, diagnose failures, rank bounded repairs and estimate variance; never confirmatory evidence

confirmation.sample_size_rule: After pilot variance/power analysis, freeze sample size and explicit compute ceiling before confirmation; abandon if unaffordable. Task is independent unit; repeats nested. Inadequate precision is inconclusive.
confirmation.status: Optional unpriced planning estimate, not mandatory or activated scope

equal_controls: aggregate agent token and wall-time caps
trial_design.randomization: Randomized paired order; seeds matched where supported, otherwise disclose independent repeats.
trial_design.runtime_eligibility: Use common supported runtime; if unavailable, stratify and disclose runtime confounding without framework-only causal claims.
trial_design.independence: Evaluator authors and seals hidden tests/tasks before runs; adapters cannot read heldouts; fresh holdout after tuning.
trial_design.fairness: Each method uses documented task-appropriate workflow with independent adapter fidelity review; count all subagents and setup.
trial_design.failures: All unsupported, timeout, exhausted, abandoned and false-completion outcomes retained and non-passing; timeouts assigned common cap.
trial_design.infrastructure_rerun: At most one under frozen classification; shared harness faults invalidate paired blocks, with original failures retained.

novice_study.design: Counterbalanced four-arm within-participant study on matched distinct tasks; no repeated solution exposure.
novice_study.uncertainty: Participant-clustered bounds; increase sample size only within preregistered budget.

screening.static: Adapter identity/fidelity and synthetic trace replay before model spend.
screening.smoke_shape: One task/family/primary arm; diagnostic only; explicit pilot resource ceiling required.

metrics: p50 and p95 end-to-end wall time

analysis.intervals: Simultaneous 95% paired task-clustered bounds with preregistered multiplicity control across all opponents/endpoints; exact/conservative bounds for rare safety events.
efficiency_populations: all assigned tasks with failures and capped timeouts
analysis.setup: Report cold setup and warm task use separately under identical accounting.
analysis.missing_cost: Unknown prices/tokens prevent a cost win claim; do not impute zero.
analysis.reporting: All outcomes, exclusions, failed seeds, per-family estimates, p50/p95, uncertainty and raw reproducible inputs. No star-count ranking.
analysis.missing_telemetry: Missing tokens/cost/duration are null/unknown, never zero; unsupported metrics cannot support wins.

claim_criteria.applies: All three primary opponents; simultaneous bounds; efficiency criteria hold on both populations.
claim_criteria.public_claim: Only this task distribution, model, resources and pins, after independent reproduction. Never universal superiority.

stop_conditions: Critical harm, compromised isolation, leaked holdouts, material protocol drift: stop campaign and investigate.
Explicit compute budget exhausted or insufficient interval precision: publish inconclusive, no automatic expansion.
Criteria met against all primary opponents: stop optimizing candidate and obtain independent reproduction.
Criteria missed: publish negative/inconclusive result; any next campaign needs reviewed improvement, new preregistration and fresh heldouts.
architecture_flags: New workflow engine or parallel governance system
Changed independent gate count or role trust boundary
Changed runtime capability requirements or dependency order
preserved_invariants: No canonical plans/manifest/run-state/debt/source edits in this proposal
No competitor superiority without actual measurements
handoff: Planner proposal only. Orchestrator coordinates independent review and any later activation; Generator supplies contracts and Evaluator performs independent checks.
